alerts.title: [BOUNTY] Medium: WASM-vs-JS hex parser differential in verifiedMint bypasses /transact/scan SPL mint binding, permanently poisoning discovered SPL notes and burning 0.009 SOL shielded gas per swap attempt (paraloom-wallet)
alerts.escrow_note: reporter settlement wallet only; venue pays post-merge from treasury; no per-ticket escrow contract
alerts.excerpt: ## Summary - **Affected Component:** `paraloom-labs/paraloom-wallet` (`main` @ `1e79eec`, v`1.7.15`) — `lib/paraloom/scan.ts` (`verifiedMint`, `scanForNotes`), compounded by `lib/paraloom/notes.ts` (`addDiscoveredNote`), `lib/paraloom/transactFlow.ts` (`spendV3`), `lib/paraloom/privateSwap.ts` (`privateSwapFromToken`), and `src/background/index.ts` (`handlePrivateSwap`) - **Cross-Repo Contract:** `paraloom-prover-wasm` (`src/lib.rs:46-54, 405-410`) and `paraloom-core` (`src/node/transact_ingress.rs:72-75, 180-185, 250`; `src/node/mod.rs:2709-2715`) - **Severity:** **Medium** (Stage 1 Bug Bount
